name: Acrylic painting
promptTemplate: Transform each image into a flattened, vibrant acrylic painting. Strip each object to solid color with simplified forms. No shading, no shadows, no gradients. Add hand-painted texture with imperfect outlines and wobbly edges. Minimal details.
promptHints: Photo of a pet in the foreground

exampleImages.alt: A gray dog sits among orange cushions in a bright, flat acrylic painting.
